title: T2 3-D: Battle Across Time
overview: A high-octane 3D live-action attraction and mini-sequel to Terminator 2: Judgment Day. John and Sarah Connor storm Cyberdyne Systems to prevent the rise of Skynet, only to come under attack from a T-1000. A reprogrammed T-800 arrives to aid them in an explosive battle that leaps from the stage into a massive 3D cinematic assault across time.
